title: Certificates of Deposit: Opening a Certificate and the Opening Deposit
content:
This page covers who may open a certificate among Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit and what the opening deposit must look like, tier by tier.

## Opening clause

A newly opened certificate starts in applied status. Its interest rate and APY are fixed on the day it is opened, and it then waits for its opening deposit.

The customer's age is taken from the date of birth on the customer profile and counted in whole years as of the opening date; it must be at least the tier's minimum age. The customer's own statement of age does not replace the profile record.

The opening deposit is one single deposit. Its size must be no smaller than the tier's minimum and no larger than the tier's maximum, and it must arrive by one of the funding methods the tier allows. Where a tier requires new money, the deposit must come from outside the bank: a transfer from any PCB account, checking or savings alike, is refused for that tier.

The tier's maximum is also the most principal one certificate of that tier may ever hold, add-ons included.

## Tier requirements

| Tier | Minimum age (years) | Smallest opening deposit | Largest principal | New money only | Funding methods accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 18 | USD 500.00 | USD 1000000.00 | No | PCB checking transfer, PCB savings or money market transfer, ACH from another bank, check, cash, wire |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 18 | USD 5000.00 | USD 500000.00 | Yes | ACH from another bank, check, cash, wire |
| 12-Month Certificate | 18 | USD 1000.00 | USD 1000000.00 | No | PCB checking transfer, PCB savings or money market transfer, ACH from another bank, check, cash, wire |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 18 | USD 2500.00 | USD 1000000.00 | No | PCB checking transfer, PCB savings or money market transfer, ACH from another bank, check, cash, wire |
| 36-Month Certificate | 18 | USD 1000.00 | USD 1000000.00 | No | PCB checking transfer, PCB savings or money market transfer, ACH from another bank, check, cash, wire |
| 60-Month Certificate | 18 | USD 1000.00 | USD 1000000.00 | No | PCB checking transfer, PCB savings or money market transfer, ACH from another bank, check, cash, wire |

## Opening checklist

- Age in whole years on the opening date, per the profile's date of birth, is at least the tier minimum.
- The opening deposit is a single deposit within the tier's smallest and largest figures, both ends included.
- The funding method appears in the tier's list; for the new-money tier, no PCB account is the source.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A customer born on the same calendar day eighteen years before the opening date is 18 in whole years that day and meets the age requirement; a customer whose eighteenth birthday falls on the following day does not.
- An opening deposit of exactly USD 2500.00 into an 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate meets the minimum; USD 2499.99 does not.
- USD 20000.00 moved from the customer's PCB savings account toward an 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate is refused as a funding method, whatever its size.
